problem: Given that  $\text{Null}(A)={[\begin{aligned}-3{x}_{3} \\ 4{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]\,:\,{x}_{3}\in R}$, find a basis for $\text{Null}(A).$

activity_context.topic_title: Finding a Basis of the Null Space of a Matrix

feedback.problem: Given that  $\text{Null}(A)={[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{4}-2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}+2{x}_{4} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}]\,:\,{x}_{3},{x}_{4}\in R}$, find a basis for $\text{Null}(A).$
feedback.worked_solution:
Any vector in $\text{Null}(A)$ has the form

$$
[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{4}-2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}+2{x}_{4} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{3},{x}_{4}\in R.
$$

Expanding, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{4}-2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}+2{x}_{4} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{4} \\ 2{x}_{4} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{4}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore a basis for $\text{Null}(A)$ is

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}
$$

since it is a linearly independent set and its vectors generate $\text{Null}(A).$
